usage: 電腦 is a noun used to refer to the device known as a computer.
You can use 電腦 as the subject or object of a sentence in daily conversation.
It's common to talk about using, buying, or fixing a 電腦 in casual speech.
You can combine 電腦 with other words to specify type, such as 手提電腦 (laptop).
When describing actions related to 電腦, verbs like 用 (use), 買 (buy), and 開 (turn on) are often used.
